== Notes ==
* Even at low rank in Water Magic, this skill increases survivability in burning-heavy areas (e.g. [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]]), helps prevent conditional Burning from triggering (e.g. from [[Glyph of Immolation]]), and prevents burning-dependent effects (e.g. from [[Searing Flames]]).

{{anomaly|This skill does not remove existing Burning, unlike other [[Skill quick reference#Skills that provide immunity to a condition|skills that grant immunity to a condition]] (e.g. [[Tainted Flesh]] removes [[Disease]]).}}

== Trivia ==
